committedCopy: The A9 noise floor: main @ 13741fa against ITSELF, two independent page loads in one browser, 16 poses x day and golden, hardware GL 1440x900, quiet machine, both sides build ae7b2be0ceaf with 0 reloads and 2,600,942 authored triangles. Every frame pair is 0.000% over 16 luma; 24 of the 32 are byte-identical JPEGs. This is what A9's --same 0.05 is derived from. ||| SIXTH PASS, 2026-09-20 -- RE-MEASURED, NOT RE-SHOT. The two Capitol poses' `wall` and `dome` rectangles were on MapLibre's own fill-extrusions, not on anything we author: `--break slopes` deleted 3,560,273 triangles and every measured number at both poses came back bit-identical. wall and dome are now read off the A-vs-B mask of that run (92-96% of each rectangle is pixels the sabotage changed by more than 3 of 255 on any channel; 86-91% at a threshold of 6), the old rectangles are kept as `downtown`/`flanking` and declared `basemap`, and every kept report was re-measured from its OWN frames with --from against the corrected night-routes.json. No frame in this file was taken again; the frames are byte-for-byte the ones the shoot produced. Capitol numbers before and after are tabulated in docs/night-implementation-plan.md sec W0a. Every shot also gained `frame.bytes`/`frame.sha1`, and `report.exit` now exists in all ten files. The '24 of the 32 are byte-identical JPEGs' claim had no field in any report to rest on. It does now and it is true: verdict.abDiff.byteIdenticalPairs 24, and meanAbsZeroPairs 26. Those are two different counts -- a pair can decode to the same pixels and still encode to different bytes -- and they had been quoted as one.

remeasure.note: the top-level when/args/gl/viewport/harnessGit describe the SHOOT that made the frames; these describe the pass that measured them and rewrote the sheets.

provenance.note: every shot in this report came from the shoot the top-level fields describe.
